text.tspan: Q35–Q39 · Build once, promote the same image everywhere
Argo CD in each cluster pulls its folder
GitOps repo: one folder per environment · promotion = a PR that changes the tag
Environments differ ONLY by runtime config and secrets (Helm values, ConfigMaps, Secrets Manager).
What you tested is byte-for-byte what reaches prod. No branch per environment: branches drift (Q39).
